note: Rue des Maisons (S02 Home) square. La Maison familiale (duvet roof, teapot chimney) centre; the Allée du Quotidien (daily-routine verbs) leaves under the wooden arch on the left, the Rue des Gestes (gesture verbs) under the stone pulley arch on the right (both lanes are linked). The cobbles at the bottom walk back to the village square (S01).
